name: Rasagiline
mechanism: Irreversible selective monoamine oxidase-B inhibitor, increases synaptic dopamine
contraindications: Concurrent use with meperidine, methadone, sympathomimetics, or serotonergic drugs without specialist advice
interactions: Serotonergic drugs (risk of serotonin syndrome), meperidine, linezolid; caution with tyramine-rich foods at high doses
monitoring: Clinical efficacy and emergence of hallucinations or orthostatic symptoms
clinicalPearls: Used for early Parkinson's disease or as adjunct to levodopa; once-daily dosing is convenient.
